blocks.x: During the years that you played with Duke you went all the way around the world, didn't you, you were in the (unintelligible) Middle East, Far East?
Yes, we did a State tour in the Middle East and went through South America and, oh, one in -- we went to a music festival in Africa.
Senegal, yeah, we were there. at the invitation of the President
Yes, well, the -- all the countries had
wasn't he a fan of the band?

No, I'm not sure, because we saw the president several times, but, you see, they had a military display there also at that time, and that's the only time I really saw him was during this military review, and the other times we'd visited the different -- the embassy there, the American Embassy and the different places that they were holding these, you know, exhibitions.
